meta.title: Session chime
meta.description: Ring when a session truly stops: no running turn, no live background job owned by it and no working subagent — an agent merely waiting on background work stays silent; a blocked goal counts as a stop and can use its own chime. Every top-level session of the instance is watched (subagent sessions never ring on their own). Configure the chimes, volume, the playback window (up to 6 hours: a short chime repeats until the window is used up) and the quiet rules — a local-time do-not-disturb window (HH:mm, may cross midnight) or rest mode can shorten or silence a chime, and rest mode also has a 🌙/🔔 switch at the sidebar foot. While ringing, a card names the finished session and offers one big stop button that ends the ring immediately; past the shortest ring (3 s by default) any click or key press also stops it, and the window ends it on its own. All fields are volatile: a saved change applies at once, with no restart and no remount. The chimes are CC0 Kenney interface sounds bundled with the plugin; playback happens in the browser, so closing the page ends the ringing.
